name: IC Interface Serial — 5V, UART/serial — DIP
description: Through-hole 5V serial interface IC cluster with 6 tier A parts in the DIP package family, supporting DIP-24_W7.62mm and DIP-24_W15.24mm footprints for UART applications.
selection_hints: Select between DIP-24_W7.62mm and DIP-24_W15.24mm footprints based on PCB width requirements.
Choose amongst representative parts including ADM205, ADM206, ADM207, ADM208, and ADM209.
Confirm requirement for 5V operating facet and UART/serial interface.
avoid_when: Surface-mount assembly is required instead of through-hole mounting.
The design requires a package family other than DIP.
Footprints other than DIP-24_W7.62mm or DIP-24_W15.24mm are required.
